title: Test-Time Memory Retrieval for VLAs
info: With zero demonstrations of a new task, the robot retrieves contact-and-motion sub-trajectories from past experience on other objects and uses them in context to act. Benchmarked against STRAP, appearance-based, and random retrieval in RoboCasa365 and LIBERO.

title: Evaluating Long-Horizon Robot Planning under Uncertainty
info: LEAP Workshop @ CoRL 2026. A benchmark of seven long-horizon household tasks in Habitat that vary the robot's initial memory and the environment, evaluating ReAct, VLM-TAMP, and Tru-POMDP across 1,350 episodes.

title: Explainable Long-Horizon TAMP in Unseen Environments
info: An explainable task and motion planning framework for long-horizon mobile manipulation that combines belief-space planning with interpretable decision traces, integrating symbolic task structure with uncertainty-aware planning in Habitat.

title: Semantic Proactive Assistance for Households
info: 3-D Spatio-Temporal mapping with Hello-Robot-Stretch to understand and track dynamic indoor environments.

title: Deep-Learning-Driven Lettuce Analysis
info: Collected the largest hyperspectral lettuce dataset and trained vision-transformer models to predict nutrient content and growth.

title: Robotic Phenotyping for Small Scale Urban Farms
info: 3D Point-cloud processing and pose-estimation pipelines for accurate plant monitoring and robotic pollination.

title: Mass Estimation and Monitoring from 3D Point Clouds
info: A hybrid cable-driven robot for non-destructive 3D monitoring of hydroponic plants
